hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git push"; then if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(blacs|labscript-devices|labscript-utils)"; then echo "Blocked: pushing to backend repo. Use explicit user confirmation." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+-(rf|r|fr)\s"; then echo "BLOCKED: rm -r/rm -rf requires explicit user approval. Ask first." >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "^mv\s.*/$"; then echo "BLOCKED: mv on directories requires explicit user approval. Ask first." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

powershell.exe -Command "[System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName('System.Windows.Forms') | Out-Null; [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show('Claude Code needs your attention', 'Claude Code') | Out-Null"
